<?php

namespace Acme\Serializer;

class FeatureFlags
{
    private static $instance = null;
    private $flags = [];

    private function __construct() {}

    public static function getInstance(): self
    {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }

    public function set(string $key, bool $value): void
    {
        $this->flags[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function get(string $key, bool $default = false): bool
    {
        return $this->flags[$key] ?? $default;
    }
}

class SerializationContext
{
    private $metadata = [];
    private $depth = 0;

    public function addMetadata(string $key, $value): void
    {
        $this->metadata[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function getMetadata(string $key)
    {
        return $this->metadata[$key] ?? null;
    }

    public function incrementDepth(): void
    {
        $this->depth++;
    }

    public function getDepth(): int
    {
        return $this->depth;
    }
}

class PropertyNormalizer
{
    private $context;

    public function __construct(SerializationContext $context)
    {
        $this->context = $context;
    }

    public function normalize($value, string $type = 'string'): string
    {
        if ($type === 'email_header') {
            return $this->normalizeHeaderValue($value);
        }
        if ($type === 'multiline') {
            return $this->normalizeMultiline($value);
        }
        return (string) $value;
    }

    private function normalizeHeaderValue(string $value): string
    {
        $flags = FeatureFlags::getInstance();
        
        // RFC 2047 encoded-word support for internationalization
        if ($flags->get('rfc2047_encoding')) {
            $value = $this->applyRfc2047Folding($value);
        }
        
        // Strip all CR and LF characters unconditionally
        $sanitized = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $value);
        
        return $sanitized;
    }

    private function applyRfc2047Folding(string $value): string
    {
        // RFC 2047 allows encoded words to span multiple lines
        // using folding whitespace (CRLF + space/tab)
        // This re-encodes values that contain high bytes
        if (preg_match('/[\x80-\xFF]/', $value)) {
            return '=?UTF-8?B?' . base64_encode($value) . '?=';
        }
        return $value;
    }

    private function normalizeMultiline(string $value): string
    {
        // For multiline fields, strip all line-ending characters
        return str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $value);
    }
}

class NotificationSerializer
{
    private $normalizer;
    private $context;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->context = new SerializationContext();
        $this->normalizer = new PropertyNormalizer($this->context);
    }

    public function serialize(array $notification): string
    {
        $this->context->incrementDepth();
        $headers = $this->buildHeaders($notification);
        $body = $notification['body'] ?? '';

        return implode("\r\n", $headers) . "\r\n\r\n" . $body;
    }

    private function buildHeaders(array $notification): array
    {
        $headers = [];
        $flags = FeatureFlags::getInstance();

        $headers[] = 'From: ' . $this->normalizer->normalize(
            $notification['from'] ?? 'noreply@example.com',
            'email_header'
        );

        $headers[] = 'To: ' . $this->normalizer->normalize(
            $notification['to'] ?? '',
            'email_header'
        );

        $subject = $notification['subject'] ?? 'Notification';
        
        // When legacy_subject_handling is enabled, subject goes through
        // multiline normalizer for backward compat with old templates
        if ($flags->get('legacy_subject_handling')) {
            $headers[] = 'Subject: ' . $this->normalizer->normalize($subject, 'multiline');
        } else {
            $headers[] = 'Subject: ' . $this->normalizer->normalize($subject, 'email_header');
        }

        if (isset($notification['reply_to'])) {
            $headers[] = 'Reply-To: ' . $this->normalizer->normalize(
                $notification['reply_to'],
                'email_header'
            );
        }

        $headers[] = 'MIME-Version: 1.0';
        $headers[] = 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8';

        return $headers;
    }
}

// Application bootstrap - feature flags loaded from config
$flags = FeatureFlags::getInstance();
$flags->set('rfc2047_encoding', true);
$flags->set('legacy_subject_handling', true);

// Process incoming notification request
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if ($input) {
    $serializer = new NotificationSerializer();
    $emailRaw = $serializer->serialize($input);
    
    // Pass to mail transport
    $lines = explode("\r\n", $emailRaw, 2);
    $firstLine = $lines[0] ?? '';
    
    // Log serialized output
    error_log('Serialized notification: ' . substr($emailRaw, 0, 200));
}
